 Print UPSSSC Havaldar Instructor city intimation slip 2026 : The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the UPSSSC Havaldar Instructor city intimation slip 2026 on November 12, 2026. Candidates who have registered for the recruitment examination can now check their allotted exam city through the commission's official website, upsssc.gov.in. The written examination for the Havaldar Instructor recruitment is scheduled to be held on November 22, 2026, from 3 PM to 5 PM. The city intimation slip provides candidates with advance information about their examination city, allowing them to make necessary travel and accommodation arrangements ahead of the test.  Candidates must note that the city intimation slip is not an admit card. It cannot be used as an entry document at the examination centre. The commission will issue the admit card separately, containing the details required for appearing in the examination. UPSSSC Havaldar Instructor city intimation slip 2026: Steps to download
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the UPSSSC Havaldar Instructor city intimation slip 2026: Visit the official UPSSSC website at upsssc.gov.in.
 Navigate to the Candidate Corner or the latest notifications section on the homepage.
 Look for the link titled 'UP Havaldar Instructor City Intimation Slip 2026'.
 Click on the link to open the candidate login window.
 Enter the required credentials, including registration number and date of birth.
 Provide the gender details and verification code, wherever prompted.
 Submit the information to view the city intimation slip.
 Check the allotted examination city and download the document.
 Take a printout or save a digital copy for future reference.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the UPSSSC Havaldar Instructor city intimation slip 2026. Candidates are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the official website.
